changes.title: Isolate locale suggestion state
changes.detail: Use the captured dictionary-group set for each request and give parallel locale decoders separate native language/spatial weight state. The single active dictionary path retains one weight array.

changes.title: Contain decoder failures and protect reloads
changes.detail: A failed or cancelled locale query releases its completion slot and leaves other native results available. Dictionary replacement, close and history mutation wait for active native queries; stale asynchronous dictionaries are closed instead of installed. Preserve the availability callback return contract across debug and release variants.

changes.title: Avoid repeated language validity queries
changes.detail: Reuse each active group's original and decapitalized validity result while adjusting multilingual confidence, preserving the existing confidence rules.
